extracted.intended_audience: public relations and communications professionals, marketers, businesses seeking press-release and PR guidance
extracted.subtask_description: A general knowledge-center landing page offering how-to articles, white papers, and thought leadership aimed at improving public relations, press-release distribution, content marketing and multimedia broadcast campaigns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose of the Knowledge Center
rubrics_metrics.description: The purpose of the Knowledge Center is to offer public relations advice and strategies, how-to articles, thought leadership pieces and other information to help you make your public relations, investor relations, marketing and multimedia broadcast campaigns more effective.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Knowledge Center as a resource for practical advice across PR, investor relations, marketing and multimedia broadcast PR. If you don’t find what you need, contact PR Newswire experts for help reaching communications goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of strong communications
rubrics_metrics.description: The principles of strong communications haven’t changed, but the way campaigns are executed is evolving in the new media age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognize that interactive media is changing execution; adapt traditional communications principles to new media channels and emerging rules of success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Optimize press releases for modern SEO and engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Optimizing Press Releases: SEO is Now About Natural Writing, Social Sharing & Interesting Content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing press releases, prioritize natural (human) writing, encourage social sharing, and produce interesting content rather than keyword-stuffed copy — SEO for press releases is now tied to readability and shareability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency as a PR driver
rubrics_metrics.description: Transparent Business Drives Great PR — availability of digital information can impact a business and its public relations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be open and transparent in communications; understand that readily available digital information affects reputation and can shape PR outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Active listening to social channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Active Listening: The Key to Relevance and PR Results — leading communications professionals discuss how listening to your Social...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor and listen to social conversations to remain relevant and to inform PR strategy; listening is presented as foundational to achieving PR results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agile engagement and content marketing process
rubrics_metrics.description: Maximizing Content Marketing: A Six-Step Plan for Agile Engagement — a veteran communications professional shares a six-step process combining... (and White Paper: The Dawn of Agile Engagement).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adopt an agile, multi-step approach to content marketing and engagement in an environment of constant multimedia content streaming; consult the referenced six-step plan/white papers for process details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain up-to-date media targeting database
rubrics_metrics.description: PR Newswire’s Audience Research Department makes thousands of updates to the database of journalists and bloggers that underpins our Agility media targeting and distribution platform.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep media contact databases current and accurate to improve targeting and distribution effectiveness; frequent updates to journalist/blogger information are required for reliable outreach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use educational events and webinars to improve PR skills
rubrics_metrics.description: Upcoming Events & Webinars listed (e.g., Newsworthiness: New Context & Opportunities for PR; Influencer Marketing Forum).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage webinars, conferences, and training events to learn best practices, new tactics, and industry trends relevant to press releases, media relations, and content marketing.
